ops.title: Repair CI lint baseline on main (golangci-lint red since 2026-07-13)
ops.description: The CI workflow's lint job (golangci-lint) has failed on every main push since at least run 29228668437 (2026-07-13 06:19 UTC, 'chore: bump fusekit to v1.0.1') — six consecutive red runs, including doc-only pushes that touch no Go code (e.g. 75ab9d6 'chore: de-expose raw semble', which changed only markdown/config yet inherited the red). Violations reported: unchecked errors, wrapped-error comparisons, %v vs %w, formatting. Log: gh run view 29339324350 --log-failed. Likely introduced by recent refactor commits; whoever owns the in-flight cc-pool refactor should fold the fixes in.

ops.text: gh run list -R yasyf/cc-pool --workflow CI -L1 shows success on a main push
